ios.desc:
2Flights is your all-in-one flight tracker for travelers all over the world. Built for frequent flyers, aviation lovers, and casual travelers, it helps you log past and upcoming flights, receive real-time updates, see where your friends are flying, and discover powerful insights about your travels.

DELAY ALERTS
- Faster than airlines announce delays
- Flight cancellation alerts

TRACK PAST AND UPCOMING FLIGHTS
- Log your upcoming and past flights
- Add you flights by scanning your boarding pass
- Or forward your flight confirmation email

REAL-TIME FLIGHT NOTIFICATIONS
Get instant alerts on:
- Gate changes
- Check in counters
- Departure and arrival updates
- Flight delays or early arrivals
- Aircraft changes
- Baggage claim info

SEE YOUR FRIENDS' FLIGHTS
Stay in sync with friends:
- View their upcoming flights
- Get notified when they take off or land
- Or when their flight is delayed or cancelled
- Compare flight stats and compete on the leaderboard

AIRCRAFT DETAILS
- See the aircraft tail number
- How many times you have flown on THIS aircraft
- Who else from your friends flew on it before

LIVE FLIGHT STATUS WITH WIDGETS
- The flight countdown before departure
- Flight progress indicator while you are in the aircraft
- Countdowns till take-off, landing and gate arrivals
- Always on your home screen

LIVE ACTIVITIES
- Gate, baggage claim always at your glance
- Always up-to-date info
- Changes according to the current context

GLOBAL FLIGHT MAP
Visualize your journey with a dynamic world map showing all your past flights, routes, and destinations.

PERSONAL TRAVEL STATS
Automatically calculate:

- Total miles and kilometers flown
- Airports and countries visited
- Most flown airlines and routes
- Longest flights, fastest segments, and more

BUILT WITH PRIVACY IN MIND
You control your data. 2Flights does not sell or share your travel history. You choose what’s visible to friends - or keep your flights completely private.

OPTIMIZED FOR ALL DEVICES
Designed for fast performance, responsive layouts, and smooth experience on all screen sizes - including tablets.

- Start Tracking Smarter
Whether you're a frequent business traveler, a student studying abroad, or someone who loves aviation, 2Flights helps you stay organized, connected, and inspired by your own journey.

Download 2Flights today and see where you’ve been - and where you’re going next.

Terms of use - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I’ve been working on 2Flights, a flight tracking app for iOS and Android. With App in the Air shutting down and Flighty being iOS-only, I wanted to build a cross-platform alternative that’s simple, real-time, and community-driven.

Features:

Add flights manually, forward itinerary emails, or import from Flighty

Get real-time notifications for delays, gates, and schedule changes

Track personal flight stats (miles flown, airports visited, aircraft types, etc.)

Global leaderboard filtered by month, year, or all-time

250+ airline liveries (including special editions) — the largest collection in any flight app

Dark mode, metric/imperial toggle, multi-language support (7 languages so far)

Tech stack:

Mobile: Flutter (single codebase for iOS & Android)

Backend: Django + PostgreSQL + Redis

Hosting: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, CloudFront)

Subscriptions: RevenueCat

Notifications: Firebase Cloud Messaging + APNs

Email parsing: GPT-4o for extracting structured data from itineraries

There’s a free tier (track up to 5 flights with full alerts), plus subscription tiers for heavier travelers. New users get a 7-day trial of the “First Class” plan.

Links:
iOS - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/2flights-live-flight-tracker/id6742110324
Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.toflights.app
website - https://2flights.io/

I’d love feedback on both the tech side (stack, scaling, architecture) and the product side (features you’d expect from a flight tracker). …
quotes.story_title: 2Flights – cross-platform flight tracker with real-time alerts
